current.text: He is expected to be Toronto's eighth man. He comes off the bench and plays in two-guard lineups with Quickley.
Toronto's projected starters are Quickley, Barrett, Leonard, Barnes and Poeltl, so he is not in the starting five.

note: He is outside our 144-player draft pool. Yahoo ranks him 238 and ESPN 186, and both sites value him at 0 USD. His projected line is mostly assists (5.3) with a weak FG% (38.5% projected, 36.7% last season) and few points and rebounds, so leave him on waivers. Early in the season, check whether his minutes rise above about 22 if a Toronto guard gets hurt, since the team has little depth after its top seven.
